action.custom: At a bright lakeside promenade, balanced lively front three-quarter stance, face toward camera and both empty open hands separated outside the torso. Blue enamel slim plates, white abdominal breastplate, small circular ear-inspired head ornaments, a short black zigzag hem sash ending in a blue spherical charm. Human skin, not a mascot suit. Full body and footwear with clear margins. Both human hands fully visible and anatomically connected to their own forearms, one thumb and four separate natural fingers per hand. No weapons, text or logos. Portrait 2:3.
